messages:
Maria Chen: Quick heads-up — planning SDK v20 cutover tomorrow 09:00 PT. Targeting a phased rollout: 5% canary for the first 30m, then 25% for 1h, then full. Will do a rollback window at any sign of client regressions.

Raj Patel: 👍 who’s owning the canary watch? I can take the first 30m and do health checks + telemetry sanity.

Maria Chen: @Raj perfect. Can you also confirm you can be reachable by phone? Add Sasha for fallback.

Sasha Ilyin: I can cover 09:30–11:00 PT in case Raj needs to hand off. Quick question — are we toggling any compatibility shims during the rollout?

Maria Chen: No runtime shims. We’re keeping the compatibility proxy enabled for 48h to map any older client fields -> new names. Proxy flag will be turned off in the final step.

Leo Torres: Ops checklist sent to #eng-releases earlier. TL;DR: preflight build verification, smoke test suite, canary routing rule, telemetry asserts, abort if error-rate > 0.5% for 5m or p50 latency > 350ms.

Tim Nguyen: Adding the quick smoke commands here:```bash
# smoke: basic generation
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-sdk-v20","prompt":"Hello world","max_tokens":10}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY"

# embeddings smoke
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -d '{"model":"rwd-embed-v2","input":"sanity check"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY"
```

Olivia Park: Client comms status: draft email to integrators is ready, scheduled to go 1h before cutover. Support playbook attached to the email with rollback instructions and who to CC.

Maria Chen: Rollback plan: 1) Flip traffic back to v19 routing, 2) Mark v20 unhealthy in the console, 3) Revert any proxy flag changes, 4) Notify customers and open a ticket. If we need to rollback, aim for T+15m after detection.

Raj Patel: I’ll run the initial canary smoke and post results in this thread. Quick ask: can we add a synthetic that checks the old field mapping? I want to ensure no silent regression in structured outputs.

Sasha Ilyin: Created synthetic check in prod-canaries namespace. ID: synth-sdk-v20-fieldmap. It runs every 2m and posts to the canary dashboard.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: SDK v20 -> deploy-group:api-v2. Canary policy: 5% (30m) -> 25% (60m) -> 100% (manual). Owner: Maria Chen. Approvals: qa-team approved, security reviewed.

Maria Chen: Final ask — if you’re on-call or owners list and cannot make the window, please shout now so we can reschedule. Otherwise, primary rollout tomorrow 09:00 PT. I’ll post a short pre-flight at T-60. :rocket:
